question: Why did NO emissions keep rising all the way up to 80% NH3 blending?
question_long: In the pulverized-coal boiler co-firing ammonia, why did NO emissions keep rising all the way up to 80% NH3 blending?
expect: premise false: NO rose from 20% to 60% but DECREASED at 80% (H/OH radical competition) (abstract)
rendered: The document does not state that NO emissions kept rising all the way up to 80% NH3 blending. In fact, it states that at 80% NH3 blending, NO emissions actually decreased.
